objectives: To train student’s Q & A ability and critical thinking.
content:
Students will choose the research articles provided by INS faculty. Faculty who provide the
papers and chosen by the students will be the coach PIs. Each student should present ~30
min for the chosen paper, and the coach PIs are encouraged to discuss with students
before the seminar. All students are required to read the designated papers before class.
